purpose: GP-VAE original TensorFlow 1.15 environment for healthcare baseline reproduction

conda.note: The Miniconda Windows installer refused the requested non-ASCII workspace path, so the local conda installation was placed at an ASCII-only path without modifying the system PATH.

dependency_notes: The original requirements.txt pins absl-py==0.7.0 and numpy==1.16.4.

Conda's Windows TensorFlow 1.15.0 package requires absl-py>=0.7.1 and numpy>=1.16.5, so absl-py and numpy were relaxed to satisfy TensorFlow 1.15.0 while keeping the original TensorFlow and TensorFlow Probability versions.
tensorflow-estimator was pinned to 1.15.1 because conda initially installed tensorflow-estimator 2.6.0, which is incompatible with TensorFlow 1.15 contrib imports.
tensorflow-gpu==1.15.0 was not installed; the environment uses the CPU/MKL TensorFlow 1.15.0 package first, because Windows TF1 GPU requires an old CUDA/cuDNN stack.

verification.import_command: F:\csdi_miniconda\Scripts\conda.exe run -n gpvae-tf115 python -c "import tensorflow as tf; print(tf.__version__); import tensorflow_probability as tfp; print(tfp.__version__)"
